svg.text: Hand in the PDF, not the .docx
ALL THREE SET BY YOU · 16 NOV · RULE ENGINE
THREE BARS, FILLED TO THE LEVEL, BESIDE THE WORD
A PART YOU ACCEPTED, WITH THE DAY YOU ACCEPTED IT
A PART YOU REJECTED · KEPT LEGIBLE, NEVER RE-PROPOSED
DUE DATE IN THE PAST AND NOT COMPLETED
WHICH ENGINE PROPOSED IT, NAMED NOT COLOURED
THE HISTORY STAYS ON THE SLIP
COMPLETING THIS TASK KEEPS EVERY MARK IT EARNED AND MOVES IT TO THE ARCHIVE AFTER THIRTY DAYS.
NOTHING IS DELETED BY COMPLETING. DELETE IS ITS OWN ACT, AND IT IS THE ONLY ONE THAT DESTROYS.
